objective.why: A one-card patch (the pilot, 2026-10-20): Goblin Matron back for Battle Hymn. The pilot keeps the tutor — Krenko and Siege-Gang to hand on a body — and the ramp axis read fifteen against a target of ten to twelve, so a ritual that only pays with a board already out is the slot the deck misses least. The ONE pre-registered row is a GUARD, not the verdict: killed by T10 may not fall below the champion's 0.90 (it read 0.902). Judged on the whole table; the tutor itself is a selection effect the goldfish does not price.
